issues.title: Ingest Columbia County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $21,746,854 across 31 funds. The largest: County Road ($5,256,546), Solid Waste Fund ($4,903,718), County General ($3,942,457). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
